instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。

generation.output_policy: At most 128 new tokens; retain all actual tokens including the stopping EOS; natural early stop is not padded; cap reached retains exactly 128 tokens; no continuation, semantic retry, or post-generation rewriting.

dose_definition: c(d) = d * original clean prompt per-layer median residual L2 / down_proj column L2; independent BF16 cast from original ratio, never scale rounded dose=1 offset
sampling: Reuse the positive experiment selection.json byte-for-byte; same 88 model/layer/channel points, no new selection or reroll

preflight.positions: Three anchors: first/middle/last point in each worker, with Q01/Q04/Q08 respectively. Each anchor runs +1 replay, zero-hook and no-hook restored. Middle Q04 then runs all five negative doses, followed by an additional no-hook restoration.

source_reuse: Reuse 3544 unique positive-panel sources after export/file/token/source identity checks. Same old clean prompt calibration and model/runtime/generation metadata; exact baseline/+1 replay and negative-then-no-hook restoration. Never silently regenerate old positive answers.
analysis: Exploratory complete raw texts, including failures and non-monotonic changes. No automatic judge, labels, neuron morality claims, or efficacy-dependent retries.
authorization_scope: User requested rerun on original models/layers/channels with fully mirrored negative doses, explicitly removing 0.75. Implement, run CPU and bounded GPU acceptance, then collect 3520 formal answers after all checks pass. Keep previous 30-minute reporting preference. No other experiments.
dose_symmetry: Signed c(d)=d*m/norm from identical original clean reference before independent BF16 cast; pairs d and -d share point/prompt/calibration/column norm. Actual activation deltas need not be exact opposites after BF16 addition to nonzero activation, and free-generation contexts diverge.
